text:
# About me
- Name: Dana Whitfield. Works as a pediatric nurse at St. Vincent's, night shifts most weeks (Oct 2026).
- Lives in Portland with partner [Sam](file:/personal/Memory/people/sam.md) and their dog [Biscuit](file:/personal/Memory/things/biscuit.md).
- Grew up in Bend, Oregon ([Bend](file:/personal/Memory/places/bend.md)).
- Prefers short answers with a list of options, no long preambles.
- Vegetarian since 2019; Sam eats fish.
- Current plans: kitchen remodel in spring, trip to Japan in April 2027.

# Sam
- Dana's partner since 2018; they met at a climbing gym in Seattle.
- Works as a high school chemistry teacher at Grant High.
- Birthday: March 14.
- Allergic to shellfish (serious, carries an EpiPen).
- Plays bass in a cover band on Thursdays.

# Linda (mom)
- Dana's mother, lives in Bend in the house Dana grew up in.
- Retired librarian. Has type 2 diabetes, manages it with diet.
- Calls every Sunday afternoon.
- Loves orchids and mystery novels; favorite author is Tana French.

# Marcus
- Dana's younger brother, 31, lives in Denver.
- Software engineer at a fintech startup.
- Married to Priya; their daughter Asha was born June 2026.
- Into trail running; ran the Leadville 100 in 2025.

# Jo Okafor
- Dana's closest friend from nursing school.
- Now an ER nurse in Sacramento.
- They do a yearly camping trip in late August, usually at Crater Lake.
- Jo doesn't drink alcohol.

# Bend, Oregon
- Where Dana grew up (1990s-2008). Mom still lives there.
- Favorite spots: Pilot Butte at sunrise, Deschutes River Trail, Pine Tavern.
- About 3.5 hours' drive from Portland over Mt. Hood.
- Went to Summit High School.

# Home (Portland)
- Craftsman house in the Sellwood neighborhood, bought 2021.
- Small backyard with raised garden beds (tomatoes, kale, herbs).
- Basement floods in heavy rain; sump pump installed Jan 2025.

# Biscuit
- Golden retriever, adopted 2022 from Oregon Humane Society.
- Born around 2020. Has hip dysplasia; on carprofen.
- Vet: Dr. Alvarez at Sellwood Animal Hospital.
- Gets anxious during fireworks and thunderstorms.

# Car
- 2019 Subaru Outback, green. Bought used in 2023.
- Oil change due every 6,000 miles; last at 48,200 miles (Sep 2026).
- Has a roof rack for the kayak.

# Climbing
- Bouldering mostly, around V4-V5. Member at Movement Portland.
- Outdoor trips to Smith Rock a few times a year.
- Wants to try lead climbing in 2027.

# Pottery
- Started a wheel-throwing class at Eastside Clay in Sep 2026, Tuesday evenings.
- Making a set of mugs for Christmas gifts.

# Japan, April 2027
Two weeks with Sam. Tokyo (4 nights), Kyoto (5), Hakone onsen (2), Osaka (3).
- Book the ryokan in Hakone by December.
- Get JR passes? Probably not worth it with the price increase.
- Sam wants a sushi place that can do shellfish-free omakase.
- Cherry blossoms usually early April in Kyoto.

# Kitchen remodel
Budget: $45k. Contractor quotes from Rosewood Builders ($48k) and Hearth & Home ($41k).
- Want: gas range, island with seating, open shelves.
- Start date target: March 2027, 6-8 weeks.
- Need a permit for moving the gas line.

# Meal plan this week
Mon: lentil soup. Tue: tofu stir fry. Wed: leftovers (night shift). Thu: salmon for Sam, mushroom risotto for me. Fri: pizza night.
Shopping: lentils, carrots, celery, tofu, broccoli, arborio rice, mushrooms, parmesan, salmon fillet.

# Mushroom risotto
1.5 cups arborio rice, 5 cups warm vegetable stock, 1 lb cremini mushrooms, 1 shallot, 1/2 cup white wine, parmesan, butter.
Toast rice, add wine, then stock a ladle at a time for ~20 minutes, stirring.

# Red lentil soup
Onion, carrot, celery, garlic, cumin, smoked paprika, 1 cup red lentils, 4 cups stock, can of tomatoes, lemon at the end. 30 minutes. Freezes well.

# November shifts
Nights: Nov 2-4, Nov 9-11, Nov 16-18, Nov 23-25 (Thanksgiving on the 26th: off).
Training day Nov 13: PALS recertification.

# Taxes 2026
- HSA contributions: $3,200 so far.
- Mortgage interest statement arrives in January.
- Donated $500 to Oregon Humane Society (receipt in email).
- Ask the accountant about the home office deduction for Sam.

# Monthly budget
Mortgage 2,350. Utilities ~280. Groceries ~700. Dog ~150 (food, meds). Car insurance 95. Savings target 1,500/month for the remodel.

# Health
- Annual physical in February with Dr. Kim.
- Mild asthma, uses an inhaler before climbing in cold weather.
- Flu shot done Oct 2026.

# Reading list
- The Overstory (half done)
- Klara and the Sun
- Braiding Sweetgrass (book club, due Nov 20)
- Sam recommended: Project Hail Mary

# Garden
- Plant garlic in October, harvest July.
- Tomatoes did poorly this year: too much shade from the neighbor's maple.
- Try a drip irrigation timer next summer.

# Home network
- Router: the Eero in the living room. Mesh node upstairs.
- Guest network for visitors. Printer is a Brother laser on the guest VLAN.
- The HomeAI server is the mini PC in the basement closet.

# Sam's 40th
March 14, 2027. Surprise dinner at Ava Gene's? Invite the band, Marcus and Priya if they can fly in, Jo.
Gift idea: a new bass amp (Fender Rumble 100).

# Chores
Dana: dishes, dog walks mornings. Sam: laundry, trash/recycling (Tuesday pickup), dog walks evenings.
Yard work: alternate Saturdays.

# Contacts
Plumber: Ace Plumbing 503-555-0142. Electrician: Bright Spark 503-555-0177. Dog sitter: Maya (text first).

# Crater Lake with Jo, Aug 2026
Mazama campground, site 42. Hiked Garfield Peak and Cleetwood Cove. Next year try the Wizard Island boat.

# Kayak
Sit-on-top, 10 ft, bought 2024. Good spots: Willamette at Sellwood Riverfront Park, Trillium Lake. Store it in the garage rafters in winter.

# Plant tracker
Tracks houseplants and when each was last watered.
Tables: plants(id, name, location, water_every_days), waterings(plant_id, watered_at).
Actions: waterPlant(plant_id) inserts a watering. The home screen lists plants due today.

# Unit meeting, Oct 8
- New charting system (Epic upgrade) goes live Jan 15.
- Staffing: two travel nurses joining nights in November.
- Reminder: badge photos for the new ID system.

# Christmas gifts
Mom: orchid pot + the new Tana French. Marcus & Priya: handmade mugs, baby book for Asha. Jo: a good headlamp. Sam: concert tickets (Khruangbin?).

# Vet visit, Oct 3
Weight 74 lb, needs to lose ~5. Continue carprofen 75mg daily. Recheck bloodwork in 3 months for liver values.

# Volunteering
One Saturday a month at the Oregon Food Bank warehouse. Next: Nov 7, 9am-12. Bring closed-toe shoes.

# Insurance
Home: State Farm, renews May. Car: Progressive, renews Aug. Pet insurance for Biscuit: Trupanion, $62/month, covers hip issues.

# Watchlist
Shōgun season 2, Severance, Past Lives (rewatch), the new Miyazaki. Sam wants to watch every Alien movie in order.

# The Fume Hoods setlist (Sam's band)
Seven Nation Army, Dreams, Mr. Brightside, Valerie, Superstition. Gig at the Lucky Labrador, Nov 21.

# Phone
Pixel 9. WireGuard profile for HomeAI when away from home. Backup codes for the bank are in the password manager, not here.
